import pandas as pd, glob, os
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
allrows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
    carrier=os.path.basename(f).split('.')[0]; d=pd.read_csv(f)
    # remove repeated export records by unique flight_id
    d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
    if 'date_utc' in d.columns:
        # AS timestamps are UTC; convert to local origin using documented offsets
        off=d['origin'].map(ap['utc_offset_hours'])
        sched_utc=pd.to_datetime(d['date_utc']+' '+d['sched_dep_utc'])
        actual_utc=pd.to_datetime(d['date_utc']+' '+d['actual_dep_utc'], errors='coerce')
        d['local_date']=(sched_utc + pd.to_timedelta(off,unit='h')).dt.date
        d['_sched']=sched_utc; d['_actual']=actual_utc
    else:
        d['local_date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']).dt.date
        d['_sched']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']+' '+d['sched_dep'])
        d['_actual']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']+' '+d['actual_dep'], errors='coerce')
    d=d[(d.local_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date()) & (d.local_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())]
    d['route']=d.apply(lambda x:'-'.join(sorted([x.origin,x.dest])),axis=1)
    d['completed']=~d.cancelled.astype(bool)
    d['delay_min']=(d['_actual']-d['_sched']).dt.total_seconds()/60
    d['delayed']=d.completed & (d.delay_min>15)
    d['carrier']=carrier
    allrows.append(d[['carrier','flight_id','route','completed','delayed','delay_min','local_date']])
x=pd.concat(allrows,ignore_index=True)
for c,g in x.groupby('carrier'):
    a=g.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('flight_id','size'),completed=('completed','sum'),delayed=('delayed','sum'))
    a['rate']=a.delayed/a.completed
    busy=a[a.scheduled==a.scheduled.max()]
    eligible=a[a.completed>=20]
    worst=eligible[eligible.rate==eligible.rate.max()]
    print('\n',c,'rows',len(g),'busy',busy.to_dict('index'),'worst',worst.to_dict('index'))
    print(a.sort_values(['scheduled','rate'],ascending=False).to_string())

import pandas as pd, glob, os
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport'); rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  s=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc); a=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc,errors='coerce')
  d['local_date']=(s+pd.to_timedelta(d.origin.map(ap.utc_offset_hours),unit='h')).dt.date
 else:
  s=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep); a=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep,errors='coerce'); d['local_date']=s.dt.date
 # crossing-midnight actuals: identify implausibly large negative clock difference, not modest early departure
 clock=(a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60
 a=a+pd.to_timedelta((clock < -60).astype(int),unit='D')
 d=d[(d.local_date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(d.local_date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())]
 d['route']=[ '-'.join(sorted((o,de))) for o,de in zip(d.origin,d.dest)]
 d['completed']=~d.cancelled.astype(bool); d['delayed']=d.completed & (((a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60)>15)
 rows.append(d[['route','completed','delayed']].assign(carrier=c))
x=pd.concat(rows)
res={}
for c,g in x.groupby('carrier'):
 q=g.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('route','size'),completed=('completed','sum'),delayed=('delayed','sum')); q['rate']=q.delayed/q.completed
 res[c]={'busy':q[q.scheduled==q.scheduled.max()].index.tolist(),'worst':q[q.completed>=20][lambda z:z.rate==z.rate.max()].index.tolist()}
 print(c, q.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).to_string(), '\n=>',res[c])

events.notes: Deduplicated repeated flight_id records (notably in B6), counted cancelled flights for busiest routes, and excluded them from delay-rate denominators. For AS, converted UTC timestamps to origin-local dates using airports.csv offsets before restricting to January-February; routes were canonicalized alphabetically.
